name: Haryāna
summary_text: This division was covered by the dedicated country dossier, which identified no deviation from the national position material enough to score separately (±0.02); it is therefore assessed at the national score. No region-specific trans-related law, enforcement series or incident pattern with a source was found for this state beyond the shared national framework; it is among the units with no constituted transgender welfare board.

sources.claim_summary: NOTE: page content did not load at fetch time (no cached text); the underlying Human Rights Watch statement (26 March 2026) argues that India's amendment to the transgender rights law is a huge setback for legal recognition, replacing the 2014 self-identification standard.

sources.title: Transgender Bill: India parliament passes amendment to redefine transgender identity amid protests
sources.claim_summary: BBC report (26 March 2026): India's parliament passed a bill amending the 2019 Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act removing self-identification, adding medical-board certification, drawing protests and a Supreme Court panel objection. National framework applying to every state, including this one.

Times of India city report (18 August 2024): a transwoman alleged a railway-police constable groped her as a 'gender check' at a Kolkata metro station; police denied the allegation and filed a counter-FIR. Cited nationally as evidence of checkpoint 'gender verification' practice toward trans-presenting travellers.
